findings: one spatial content query initialized from weighted video/text representation
query_decoder expands one per-frame query to [t,1,256], not multiple object instance queries
aux_outputs are decoder-layer predictions, not independently validated referent hypotheses
old cold capture caches final boxes and two offset records; does not save aux trajectories
conclusion: local geometry correction only supported by currently accessible saved outputs; no universal claim that TA-STVG can never yield alternative instances
